sources.title: lenhanm1/vietocr-uit-printed-finetune · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: VietOCR UIT-HWDB and Printed Pilot A small 100-iteration pipeline pilot trained on 10 UIT-HWDB-line training images and 10 owner-reviewed printed line crops. The 20 samples were split 8/2 per source for training and validation. This artifact checks that fine-tuning and export work; it is not a quality benchmark.
